MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #18 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which sentence means "The chair is under the table."? (1 mark)
   A. 电视在客厅。
   B. 椅子在桌子下。
   C. 沙发在门旁边。
   D. 卧室里有床。

2. Which Chinese word means "toilet"? (1 mark)
   A. 前面 qiánmiàn
   B. 厕所 cèsuǒ
   C. 桌子 zhuōzi
   D. 上面 shàngmiàn

3. Which pattern says what is in a room? (1 mark)
   A. 有 + place + thing
   B. Thing + 有 + 里 + place
   C. Place + 里 + 有 + thing
   D. Place + thing + 里

4. Read the pinyin: kètīng lǐ yǒu diànshì. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. There is a television in the living room.
   B. The door is on the left.
   C. The television is on the table.
   D. The window is above the sofa.

5. What does 休息 (xiūxi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To rest
   B. Today
   C. Church
   D. Yesterday

6. What does 二 (èr) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Two
   B. One
   C. Eight
   D. Five

7. Read the pinyin: wǒ xīngqīliù zài jiā xiūxi. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Wednesday I go to school.
   B. On Friday, go to the mosque.
   C. Today is Wednesday.
   D. On Saturday I rest at home.

8. Which sentence means "Tomorrow is Thursday."? (1 mark)
   A. 星期五,去清真寺。
   B. 明天是星期四。
   C. 今天星期三。
   D. 我星期三去学校。

9. How many strokes does 日 have? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 3
   C. 6
   D. 4

10. What does 礼物 (lǐwù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Gift
   B. We
   C. To play
   D. Knife

11. Read the pinyin: wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is a banana.
   B. I drink tea.
   C. For breakfast I eat bǐng.
   D. I like to drink tea.

12. What does 水 (shuǐ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Vegetables
   B. Water
   C. To eat
   D. Beef

13. What does 鼻子 (bízi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Nose
   B. Head
   C. To speak
   D. Eye

14. Which Chinese word means "tooth"? (1 mark)
   A. 用 yòng
   B. 牙 yá
   C. 看 kàn
   D. 摸 mō

15. Which sentence means "Today it rains"? (1 mark)
   A. 雨下今天。
   B. 今天雨下。
   C. 下今天雨。
   D. 今天下雨。

16. What does 很 (hěn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Very
   B. Big
   C. Small
   D. Cloud

17. Which sentence means "The window is above the sofa."? (1 mark)
   A. 沙发在门旁边。
   B. 电视在哪儿?
   C. 窗户在沙发上面。
   D. 冰箱在厨房。

18. What does 右边 (yòubian) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Television
   B. Right side
   C. Things
   D. Kitchen

19. What should you do if you make a mistake while presenting? (1 mark)
   A. Stay calm, breathe and say it again
   B. Run away
   C. Stop and cry
   D. Blame a friend

20. What should a group do first when planning a showcase? (1 mark)
   A. Skip practice
   B. Choose an item and make a plan
   C. Throw away materials
   D. Perform at once

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Give three tips for neat Chinese handwriting. (3 marks)

22. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 花园 and 房子. (2 marks)

23. Write the stroke names of 手 in order. (3 marks)

24. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 午饭 and 快乐. (2 marks)

25. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 星期一 and 几. (2 marks)

26. Give one challenge of writing Chinese and one way to overcome it. (2 marks)

27. Explain the sentence pattern for saying where something is, with an example. (3 marks)

28. Give three things to do when planning a showcase item. (3 marks)

29. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 水, 没有 and 门. (3 marks)

30. Describe how to make the character 手 using local materials. (3 marks)

31. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is a banana." (2 marks)

32. Write "Happy birthday to you" in characters and pinyin. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #18 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — 椅子在桌子下。
   椅子在桌子下。 (yǐzi zài zhuōzi xià.) means "The chair is under the table.".

2. B — 厕所 cèsuǒ
   厕所 (cèsuǒ) means toilet.

3. C — Place + 里 + 有 + thing
   For example 卧室里有床。

4. A — There is a television in the living room.
   kètīng lǐ yǒu diànshì. is 客厅里有电视。, which means "There is a television in the living room.".

5. A — To rest
   休息 (xiūxi) means to rest.

6. A — Two
   二 (èr) means two.

7. D — On Saturday I rest at home.
   wǒ xīngqīliù zài jiā xiūxi. is 我星期六在家休息。, which means "On Saturday I rest at home.".

8. B — 明天是星期四。
   明天是星期四。 (míngtiān shì xīngqīsì.) means "Tomorrow is Thursday.".

9. D — 4
   日 has four strokes.

10. A — Gift
   礼物 (lǐwù) means gift.

11. C — For breakfast I eat bǐng.
   wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng. is 我早饭吃饼。, which means "For breakfast I eat bǐng.".

12. B — Water
   水 (shuǐ) means water.

13. A — Nose
   鼻子 (bízi) means nose.

14. B — 牙 yá
   牙 (yá) means tooth.

15. D — 今天下雨。
   今天 + 下雨.

16. A — Very
   很 (hěn) means very.

17. C — 窗户在沙发上面。
   窗户在沙发上面。 (chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn.) means "The window is above the sofa.".

18. B — Right side
   右边 (yòubian) means right side.

19. A — Stay calm, breathe and say it again
   Everyone makes mistakes.

20. B — Choose an item and make a plan
   A plan says who does what.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Keep characters the same size, keep strokes firm and straight, leave equal spaces, write in the right stroke order, do not join separate strokes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: 花园: huāyuán, garden. 房子: fángzi, house.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: 撇, 横, 横, 竖钩.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two, 2 marks for three, 3 marks for all four.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: 午饭: wǔfàn, lunch. 快乐: kuàilè, happy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: 星期一: xīngqīyī, Monday. 几: jǐ, which number, how many.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example, remembering stroke order; practise a few characters each day and use flashcards.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Thing + 在 + place, with 上 or 下 at the end when needed. For example 电视在桌子上。
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the pattern, 1 mark for the example, 1 mark for the translation.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: Choose an item, decide who does what, list the materials and words needed, practise several times.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: 水: shuǐ, water. 没有: méiyǒu, there is not. 门: mén, door.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: Choose pebbles, sand, maize grains, sticks or plasticine. Lay out each stroke in the correct order: 撇, 横, 横, 竖钩. Check the order with a partner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the material, 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for checking.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是香蕉。 zhè shì xiāngjiāo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.
